description: You are a Business Continuity Planner at a mid-size financial services firm. The CISO has asked you to create a formal Ransomware Incident Response process diagram in Wondershare EdrawMax. Using a cross-functional swimlane (pool) layout, build a comprehensive diagram that maps your firm's ransomware response from initial threat detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. The swimlane diagram must include distinct lanes for different response teams — at minimum: IT Security, Executive Management, and Legal/Compliance — and must show the full response workflow with decision points (diamond shapes), action steps (rectangles), and directional connectors representing handoffs between teams. The document must have at least two pages: Page 1 is the swimlane flowchart; Page 2 is an Executive Summary or Incident Impact Assessment page containing written text that addresses incident scope, affected systems, recovery time objective (RTO), and key lessons learned. Apply a professional color theme to the diagram. Save the completed diagram as '/home/ga/ransomware_ir_flowchart.eddx'.
